methodology: Exhaustive user-journey audit of ALL 64 source files (23 tabs + 10 components + 26 API modules + 5 infra files). Every onClick, onChange, onKeyDown, useEffect, useCallback, useState traced.

critical_findings.summary: Token stored in localStorage — XSS-vulnerable. Full account takeover if any XSS exists.
critical_findings.fix: Use httpOnly cookies (requires backend changes) or robust CSP

critical_findings.summary: XSS via dangerouslySetInnerHTML on AI response. Regex-based markdown-to-HTML is fragile and bypassable.
critical_findings.fix: Use proper markdown library (marked + DOMPurify) instead of chained regex

critical_findings.summary: Stale closure in popstate handler. showConfirm captured from wrong render cycle can overwrite existing confirmation dialog.
critical_findings.fix: Use ref-based pattern for popstate handler

fixes_applied.fix: Added role=dialog, aria-modal=true, Escape key handlers to all 7 modal instances
Added isFinite guard to formatCurrency to handle Infinity/NaN
Added jobRunning loading state, disabled buttons during execution, confirmation dialog before running expensive AI jobs
Added regEventsInFlightRef guard to prevent concurrent registration events fetches
Added grnAlertsInFlightRef guard to prevent concurrent GRN alerts fetches
Added storage event listener for cross-tab session sync (logout in one tab logs out all)
Reset page to 0 when pageSize changes to prevent empty event table
Create User button disabled when name or email is empty
Added selectConvRef counter for stale response guard, removed pre-fetch message clear to prevent flash, added messagesLoading state
Changed Promise.all to Promise.allSettled to preserve partial results on failure
Added per-phone validation for broadcast recipients (10-15 digits)
Clear broadcast form (phones + message) after successful send
Removed misleading role=button from product name cell, replaced with title tooltip
Approve & Publish now catches approve failure and skips publish if approve fails
